idea-plugin.name: Mpx.js
idea-plugin.description:
Provides Mpx.js mini-program framework support in WebStorm.

Features

  • Completion of components, directives, props, and methods in templates
  • Navigation from the component, directives, and event handlers to their definition
  • Coding assistance for different languages inside the template, script, and style tags in .mpx files
  • Extract component and rename component refactorings
  • WeChat Mini Program directives, events, and component metadata

Getting started

See the Mpx.js documentation.
